title: Hopkins-Levitzki Type Theorems for Groupoid Graded Rings
summary: We continue the study of the basic theory of object-unital groupoid graded rings. In this work, we are especially interested in nilpotency conditions on the graded Jacobson radical. We introduce the concept of left/right objectwise nilpotency of graded ideals, and prove that this condition is appropriate for obtaining graded generalizations of the Hopkins--Levitzki theorem. Although this condition is not symmetric, we show that its two-sided version is suitable for defining gr-semiprimary rings.
